column1: **surflayerSelector:** Monin-Obukhov surface layer selector: 0=off; 1=surface kinematic heat flux (surflayer_wth); 2=sking temperature rate (surflayer_tr)
**ssurflayer_z0:** Roughness length (momentum) when surflayerSelector > 0
**ssurflayer_z0t:** Roughness length (temperature) when surflayerSelector > 0
**ssurflayer_z0tdyn:** Dynamic z0t calculation following Zilitinkevich (1995) approach: 0= off 1= constant Zilitinkevich coeff 2=variable Zilitinkevich coeff
**ssurflayer_wth:** Kinematic sensible heat flux at the surface when surflayerSelector = 1
**ssurflayer_tr:** Temperature rate at the surface when surflayerSelector = 2 (>0 for warming; <0 for cooling)
**ssurflayer_wq:** Sensible heat flux at the surface (kg/kg m s-1) when surflayerSelector = 1 *C-M if moistureSelector==1*
**ssurflayer_qr:** Water vapor rate (kg/kg h-1) when surflayer Selector = 2 *C-M if moistureSelector==1*
**ssurflayer_idealsine:** Selector for idealized sinusoidal surface heat flux or skin temperature forcing
**ssurflayer_ideal_ts:** Start time in seconds for the idealized sinusoidal surface forcing *C-M if surflayer_idealsine > 0*
**ssurflayer_ideal_te:** End time in seconds for the idealized sinusoidal surface forcing *C-M if surflayer_idealsine > 0*
**ssurflayer_ideal_amp:** Maximum amplitude of the idealized sinusoidal surface forcing *C-M if surflayer_idealsine > 0*
**ssurflayer_ideal_qts:** Start time in seconds for the idealized sinusoidal surface forcing (qv) *C-M if moistureSelector==1 and surflayer_idealsine > 0*
**ssurflayer_ideal_qte:** End time in seconds for the idealized sinusoidal surface forcing (qv) *C-M if moistureSelector==1 and surflayer_idealsine > 0*
**ssurflayer_ideal_qamp:** Maximum amplitude of the idealized sinusoidal surface forcing (qv) *C-M if moistureSelector==1 and surflayer_idealsine > 0*
**ssurflayer_qskin_input:** Selector for file input (restart) value for qskin under surflayerSelector == 2 *C-O if moistureSelector==1*
**ssurflayer_offshore:** Offshore selector: 0=off;1=on
**ssurflayer_offshore_visc:** Viscous term on z0m: 0=off; 1=on

**ssurflayer_offshore_opt:** Offshore roughness parameterization: ==0 (Charnock); ==1 (Charnock with variable alpha); ==2 (Taylor & Yelland); ==3 (Donelan); ==4 (Drennan); ==5 (Porchetta) *C-M if surflayer_offshore > 0*
**ssurflayer_offshore_dyn:** Selector to use parameterized ocean parameters: 0=off; 1=on *C-O if surflayer_offshore > 0*
**ssurflayer_offshore_hs:** Significant wave height *C-M if surflayer_offshore > 0 and surflayer_offshore_dyn == 0 and surflayer_offshore_opt == 2; 3; 4; or 5*
**ssurflayer_offshore_lp:** Peak wavelength *C-M if surflayer_offshore > 0 and surflayer_offshore_dyn == 0 and surflayer_offshore_opt == 2*
**ssurflayer_offshore_cp:** Wave phase speed *C-M if surflayer_offshore > 0 and surflayer_offshore_dyn == 0 and surflayer_offshore_opt == 3; 4; or 5*

**ssurflayer_offshore_theta:** Wave/wind angle *C-M if surflayer_offshore > 0 and surflayer_offshore_dyn == 0 and surflayer_offshore_opt == 5 or surflayer_offshore > 0 and surflayer_offshore_dyn==1 and surflayer_offshore_opt == 5*
